flan.command.help.1: Shows all available commands or info for the given command.
flan.command.add.1: Creates a claim with the given positions. Same as using the claim tool.
flan.command.add.2: ▶ all: Uses up all remaining blocks for a squared claim centered around the player
flan.command.add.3: ▶ rect: Creates a rectangular claim of given size centered around the player
flan.command.expand.1: Expands the current claim by the given amount in the direction the player is looking
flan.command.menu.1: Opens the claim menu at the players position
flan.command.setHome.1: Standing in a claim with sufficient permission sets that claims home to the players position
flan.command.trapped.1: If in a claim not owned by the player attempts to teleport the player out of it after 5 seconds.
flan.command.unlockDrops.1: Unlocks dropped items from death so other players can pick them up too. Or all of the given players (needs OP)
flan.command.personalGroups.1: Opens the gui to edit personal groups.
flan.command.info.1: Prints infos about the claim at the current position
flan.command.transferClaim.1: Gives ownership of the claim to the specified player. Only works if you're the claim owner.
flan.command.deleteAllSubClaims.1: Deletes all subclaims of the current claim.
flan.command.list.1: Lists all claims you have. If op also gives ability to list other players claims.
flan.command.buy.1: Buys <amount> claimblocks. Needs gunpowder currency installed.
flan.command.sell.1: Sells <amount> claimblocks. Needs gunpowder currency installed.
flan.command.claimMessage.1: Sets the claims message. Use "$empty" to remove the message
flan.command.group.1: ▶ add|remove: Adds/removes the group with that name. Also editable via the claim menu.
flan.command.group.2: ▶ players: Adds/remove a player to/from the group. If overwrite then will overwrite the players current group else does nothing. Also editable via the claim menu.
flan.command.fakePlayer.1: Adds/remove a fakeplayer to/from the claim
flan.command.teleport.0: teleport { <self | global> <claim name | claim uuid> } | { other <player> <claim name | claim uuid> }
flan.command.teleport.1: Teleport to the given claims home position. Use global to teleport to admin claims
flan.command.permission.1: Sets global/group/personal permissions. Also editable via the claim menu (for group perm right click on the group in the menu).
flan.command.ignoreList.0: ignoreList <add | remove> <flan:block_break | flan:block_use | flan:entity_attack | flan:entity_use | flan:item | flan:item_drop | flan:item_pickup> <value>
flan.command.ignoreList.1: Add/remove an entry to/from the claims ignore list. Interactions in this list bypass permission checks
flan.command.bypass.1: Switches to admin mode ignoring all claims and permissions.
flan.command.readGriefPrevention.1: Parses data from the GriefPrevention plugin to Flan
flan.command.setAdminClaim.1: Sets a claim to an admin claim.
flan.command.listAdminClaims.1: Lists all admin claims in the current world.
flan.command.adminDelete.1: Force deletes the current claim or deletes all claims from the specified player.
flan.command.giveClaimBlocks.1: Gives a player additional claim blocks.
flan.command.giveClaimBlocks.2: ▶ base: Gives base blocks instead of additional blocks

flan.expandTooLarge: Claim would exceed maximum allowed size!
flan.expandBeyondParent: Cannot expand subclaim beyond parent claim boundaries!
flan.expandFailed: Failed to expand claim due to an unknown error.
